name: aerio
description: A clean asynchronous runtime (IO monad) for TypeScript.
author: Ge Gao (Snowflyt) <gaoge011022@gmail.com>

scripts.build: rimraf dist && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run compile && node -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.cpSync('package.json', 'dist/package.json')" && json -I -f dist/package.json -e "delete this.private; delete this.workspaces; delete this.scripts; delete this.devDependencies" && node -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; ['LICENSE', 'README.md'].forEach((name) => fs.cpSync(name, 'dist/' + name)); fs.cpSync('docs', 'dist/docs', { recursive: true })"
scripts.build:dev: rimraf dist && npm run compile:dev && node -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; fs.cpSync('package.json', 'dist/package.json')" && json -I -f dist/package.json -e "delete this.private; delete this.workspaces; delete this.scripts; delete this.devDependencies" && node -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; ['LICENSE', 'README.md'].forEach((name) => fs.cpSync(name, 'dist/' + name)); fs.cpSync('docs', 'dist/docs', { recursive: true })"
scripts.esm-to-cjs: node -e "import { parseArgs } from 'node:util'; import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; const { values } = parseArgs({ args: process.argv.slice(1), options: { 'dir': { type: 'string' }, 'rename-cjs': { type: 'boolean' } }, strict: true }); for (const ent of fs.readdirSync(values.dir, { withFileTypes: true, recursive: true })) { if (!ent.isFile()) continue; const file = path.join(ent.parentPath, ent.name); let lines = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf-8').split(/\r?\n/); for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) { let newLine = ''; for (const regexp of [/(from ['\u0022])([^'\u0022]+?)(['\u0022];?\s*)$/u, /(import\(['\u0022])([^'\u0022]+?)(['\u0022]\))/u]) { let match = null; while ((match = lines[i].match(regexp))) { newLine += lines[i].slice(0, match.index); lines[i] = lines[i].slice(match.index + match[0].length); newLine += match[1] + (( fs.existsSync(path.join(path.dirname(file), match[2])) || fs.existsSync(path.join(path.dirname(file), match[2].replace(/\.js$/, values['rename-cjs'] ? '.cjs' : '.js'))) ) ? match[2].replace(/\.js$/, values['rename-cjs'] ? '.cjs' : '.js') : match[2]) + match[3]; } } newLine += lines[i]; lines[i] = newLine; } let inImport = false; const exportAlls = []; const exportSymbols = []; if (file.endsWith('.js')) { for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) { if (inImport && lines[i].match(/from ['\u0022][^'\u0022]+?['\u0022];?\s*$/u)) inImport = false; if (inImport) { lines[i] = lines[i].replace(/(\S+?) as (\S+?)/, '$' + 1 + ': $' + 2); continue; } if (lines[i].startsWith('import ') && !lines[i].match(/from ['\u0022][^'\u0022]+?['\u0022];?\s*$/u)) inImport = true; if (lines[i].startsWith('export ')) { let match = lines[i].match(/^export \* from (['\u0022][^'\u0022]+?['\u0022]);?\s*$/u); if (match) { lines[i] = '<\|REMOVED|>'; exportAlls.push('require(' + match[1] + ')'); continue; } match = lines[i].match(/^export \* as (\S+?) from (['\u0022][^'\u0022]+?['\u0022]);?\s*$/u); if (match) { lines[i] = '<\|REMOVED|>'; exportSymbols.push(match[1] + ': require(' + match[2] + ')'); continue; } match = lines[i].match(/^export {([^}]*?)}\s*;?\s*$/); if (match) { lines[i] = '<\|REMOVED|>'; exportSymbols.push(...match[1].split(',').map((part) => part.trim()).filter(Boolean).map((part) => part.includes(' as ') ? part.split(' as ').map((sym) => sym.trim()) : [part, part]).map(([orig, to]) => to + ': ' + orig), ); continue; } match = lines[i].match(/^export \{([^}]+?)\} from (['\u0022][^'\u0022]+?['\u0022]);?\s*$/u); if (match) { lines[i] = '<\|REMOVED|>'; exportSymbols.push(...match[1].split(',').map((part) => part.trim()).filter(Boolean).map((part) => part.includes(' as ') ? part.split(' as ').map((sym) => sym.trim()) : [part, part], ).map(([orig, to]) => to + ': require(' + match[2] + ').' + orig), ); continue; } if (lines[i].startsWith('export {')) { lines[i] = '<\|REMOVED|>'; const symbols = []; for (let j = i + 1; j < lines.length; j++) { const match = lines[j].match(/from (['\u0022][^'\u0022]+?['\u0022]);?\s*$/u); if (match) { lines[j] = '<\|REMOVED|>'; i = j + 1; exportSymbols.push(...symbols.map(([orig, to]) => to + ': require(' + match[1] + ').' + orig), ); break; } symbols.push( lines[i].includes(' as ') ? lines[i].split(' as ').map((sym) => sym.trim()) : [lines[i].trim(), lines[i].trim()], ); lines[j] = '<\|REMOVED|>'; } } if (lines[i].match(/^export (const|let|var) {/)) throw new Error('Destructuring export is not currently supported'); try { exportSymbols.push( lines[i].match( /^export\s+(const|let|var|function|class)\s+([^\s(]+)(\s*[(={]|\s+extends)/, )[2], ); } catch (e) { console.error( 'Error while processing line ' + i + ' of file \u0022' + file + '\u0022: ' + lines[i], ); throw e; } lines[i] = lines[i].replace(/^export\s+/, ''); continue; } const match = lines[i].match(/^import \{([^}]+?)\} from (['\u0022][^'\u0022]+?['\u0022])(;?\s*)$/u); if (match) { lines[i] = 'const { ' + match[1].split(',').map((part) => part.trim()).filter(Boolean).map((part) => part.includes(' as ') ? part.split(' as ').map((sym) => sym.trim()) : [part, part], ).map(([orig, to]) => (orig === to ? orig : orig + ': ' + to)).join(', ') + ' } = require(' + match[2] + ')' + match[3]; continue; } lines[i] = lines[i].replace(/^import \* as /, 'const ').replace(/^import {/, 'const {').replace(/from (['\u0022][^'\u0022]+?['\u0022])(;?\s*)$/, '= require($' + 1 + ')$' + 2); } lines.push('module.exports = ' + (exportAlls.length ? 'Object.assign({}, ' + exportAlls.join(', ') + ', ' : '') + '{', ...exportSymbols.map((sym, i, arr) => '  ' + sym + (i !== arr.length - 1 ? ',' : '')), '}' + (exportAlls.length ? ')' : '') + ';', ''); } lines = lines.filter((line) => line !== '<\|REMOVED|>'); const newLines = []; let isLastLineEmpty = true; for (const line of lines) { if (isLastLineEmpty && !line.trim()) continue; newLines.push(line); isLastLineEmpty = !line.trim(); } lines = newLines; const newFile = file.endsWith('.js') ? file.replace(/.js$/, values['rename-cjs'] ? '.cjs' : '.js') : (file.endsWith('.d.ts') && (fs.existsSync(file.replace(/.d.ts$/, '.js')) || fs.existsSync(file.replace(/.d.ts$/, '.cjs'))) ) ? file.replace(/.d.ts$/, values['rename-cjs'] ? '.d.cts' : '.d.ts') : file; fs.rmSync(file); fs.writeFileSync(newFile, lines.join('\n')); }" --
scripts.postinstall: node -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; import path from 'node:path'; const hooksDir = path.join(process.cwd(), '.githooks'); const gitHooksDir = path.join(process.cwd(), '.git/hooks'); if (fs.existsSync(gitHooksDir)) { fs.readdirSync(hooksDir).forEach(file => { const srcFile = path.join(hooksDir, file); const destFile = path.join(gitHooksDir, file); fs.copyFileSync(srcFile, destFile); if (process.platform !== 'win32' && !file.endsWith('.cmd')) { fs.chmodSync(destFile, 0o755); } }); }"
scripts.measure-size: rimraf dist && npm run compile:dev && node -e "import { parseArgs } from 'node:util'; import fs from 'node:fs'; import { rimraf } from 'rimraf'; import { rollup } from 'rollup'; import nodeResolve from '@rollup/plugin-node-resolve'; import terser from '@rollup/plugin-terser'; import prettyBytes from 'pretty-bytes'; import { gzipSizeSync } from 'gzip-size'; import brotliSize from 'brotli-size'; const fixed = 3; const { positionals } = parseArgs({ args: process.argv.slice(1), allowPositionals: true }); const bundle = await rollup({ input: positionals[0] ?? 'dist/index.js', plugins: [...(positionals[0] ? [nodeResolve()] : []), terser()] }); try { await bundle.write({ format: 'esm', file: 'dist/aerio.min.js' }); } finally { await bundle.close(); } const content = fs.readFileSync('dist/aerio.min.js', 'utf-8'); console.log('gzip:  ', '\x1b[33m' + prettyBytes(content.length, { maximumFractionDigits: fixed }) + '\x1b[0m (bundled+minified)', '→', '\x1b[36m' + prettyBytes(gzipSizeSync(content), { maximumFractionDigits: fixed }) + '\x1b[0m'); console.log('brotli:', '\x1b[33m' + prettyBytes(content.length, { maximumFractionDigits: fixed }) + '\x1b[0m (bundled+minified)', '→', '\x1b[36m' + prettyBytes(brotliSize.sync(content), { maximumFractionDigits: fixed }) + '\x1b[0m'); await rimraf('dist')"
